simple.meaning: אוֹן (ʼôwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “ability , power , (figuratively) wealth.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אוֹן (H202) appears 12 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 49:3, with occurrences in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אוֹן (H202) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אוֹן (H202) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אוֹן (ʼôwn) / H202 is traced through Genesis 49:3, Deuteronomy 21:17, Job 18:7, Job 18:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength;
but he shall acknowledge the firstborn, the son of the hated, by giving him a double portion of all that he has; for he is the beginning of his strength. The right of the firstborn is his.
The steps of his strength will be shortened.
His children will seek the favor of the poor.
Look now, his strength is in his thighs.
and struck all the firstborn in Egypt,
He struck also all the firstborn in their land,
Lift up your eyes on high,
He gives power to the weak.
Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed;
“But I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt.

definitions.full: H202. on I. אוֺן noun masculine vigour, wealth — absolute Hosea 12:9 , suffix אוֺנִי Gen 49:3 + etc.; plural אוֺנִים Psa 78:51 +. 1 manly vigour אֶתאֱֿלֹהִים שָׂרָה בְּאוֺנוֺ Hosea 12:4 (of Jacob); אוֺן רֵאשִׁית beginning of manly vigour Gen 49:3 (of Reuben, first-born of Jacob); Deut 21:17 ; Psa 105:36 (firstborn Egyptians), so 78:51 , אוֺנִים רֵאשִׁית where ׳א is assimilated to מִצְרַיִם , or intensive plural 2 strength of man Job 18:7 , 12 ; behemoth 40:16 ; plural intensive אוֺנִים מֵרֹב Isa 40:26 because of the abundance of great strength (of God); of man אוֺנִים אֵין 40:29 one not having strength ; אוֺנִים תּוֺחֶלֶת Prov 11:7 hope in strength (not the hope of iniquity RV, or of unjust men AV). 3 wealth Job 20:10 ; Hosea 12:9 א ׳מָצָאתִי לִי (|| עָשַׁרְתִּי ).
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same as 205 (in the sense of effort , but successful);
